meSpeak 2.0.2
==============

The browser pronunciation runtime in this directory is built from the
`mespeak` npm package version 2.0.2.

Package facts recorded at staging time:

- package name: `mespeak`
- version: `2.0.2`
- author: Norbert Landsteiner
- package repository: `git://github.com/mikolalysenko/mespeak.git`
- package license metadata: `GPL`
- upstream project note in `src/index.js`: meSpeak is based on speak.js and
  includes eSpeak code under the GNU GPL.

The files are staged locally so the deployed web image does not rely on a
public CDN at runtime.
